The revised Literature report now supplies a substantive distinct numerical Rivoal lower-dimension mechanism, resolving the original significance hold.

Rivoal Theorem 1 has exact quantifiers: every epsilon>0, all N>N0(epsilon), dim_Q span(1,zeta(3),...,zeta(2N+1)) >=(1-epsilon)log N/(1+log 2). The odd depth-one restriction is meaningful; unrestricted cumulative weights already have a linear bound from even zeta values and pi transcendence. No best-current-constant claim is made.

For odd a>=3, integer 1<=r<a/2 and even m>0, the supplied rational function is proper and decays faster than t^-1. Its initial rm terms vanish and later terms are positive, ensuring convergent nonzero S_m. Reflection t -> -t-m-2 swaps numerator products and gives sign (-1)^(a(m+1)); reflected coefficients satisfy c_(i,m-j)=(-1)^(i+1)c_(i,j), so even zeta coefficients vanish. The total simple-pole coefficient is zero from decay at infinity. Grouping those terms before the limit cancels their common harmonic divergence, leaving exactly the finite rational -sum c_(i,j) H_j^(i), never treating zeta(1) as a number.

Primary Lemmas 2–5 supply positive-integral decay, actual exponential limit, coefficient bound B=2^(a-2r)(2r+1)^(2r+1) and q_m^(a-i)P_i integrality. Multiplication by q_(2n)^a gives integer coefficients, alpha=(e^a s)^2 and beta=(e^a B)^2. Applying the credited Nesterenko criterion yields 1-log alpha/log beta>=f/g with exactly the displayed f,g; the even-subsequence factors two cancel. These deep quantitative inputs are credited, not independently reproved.

Taylor expansion of x log x at A=r(a+1), d=a-2r has error O(d^2/A). For r=floor(a/log^2 a), it yields f=a log r+O(a+r log r), g=(1+log 2)a+O(r log r), r log r=o(a), and log r=log a-2log log a+o(1). Hence f/g~log a/(1+log 2); because log(e^a s)<=g-f, its growth also verifies alpha<1 before invoking the criterion. a=2N+1 and an arbitrarily small epsilon adjustment recover the exact eventual theorem.

The quotient inequality dim((E+W_(M,N))/E)>=D_N-(M+1)-dim E follows from V_N=V_M+W and dim(E intersect W)<=dim E, with no cross-weight direct sum assumption. Generator selection gives independent classes modulo any fixed finite-dimensional E. For M=floor(kappa log N), 0<kappa<1/(1+log 2), the explicit epsilon condition makes the stated logarithmic coefficient positive and proves the growing-cutoff consequence. Counting at least D_N-1 irrational generators is justified by retaining 1 in V_N; no prescribed odd value is identified.

Secondary monomial rank formula follows by weight-preserving absolutely convergent stuffle and division by zeta(2)^(3m), then the minimal polynomial of u=zeta(3)^2/zeta(2)^3. Brown gives only numerical spanning, with index reversal tracked; weight-six words 222 and 33 are reversal invariant. zeta(222)=pi^6/7!=3 zeta(6)/16 and zeta(33)=(zeta(3)^2-zeta(6))/2 give Z6=S1, whose dimension two remains equivalent to u irrational. The cumulative odd theorem does not prove fixed-weight Zagier dimensions or period-map injectivity.
